strings.name: Howard Schultz
strings.summary: Raised in New York public housing, Schultz worked in sales after college and joined Starbucks in 1982. He later acquired it and built a global coffee chain, emphasising stores, benefits and brand culture and repeatedly returning to management. His opposition to unions drew labour controversy. At a 2023 Senate hearing he denied company wrongdoing; he left the board that year.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Developed Starbucks into a global coffee-chain brand, influencing store experiences, labour relations and consumer culture.
